news.title: Praxis Home Retail Limited Announces Resignation of Category Head Ketan Gandhalikar, Effective January 2, 2026
news.body: Praxis Home Retail Limited announced that Mr. Ketan Gandhalikar, Category Head and Senior Management Personnel, has tendered his resignation due to personal reasons and better opportunities. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on January 2, 2026. Mr. Gandhalikar confirmed that there is no other material reason other than that mentioned in his resignation letter. Mr. Gandhalikar was the Category Head at Praxis Home Retail Limited.
